prompt.text:
Implement a new function `validateWorkshopRequest(topic, seatCount, facilitatorId)`.

`topic` must be a string containing at least one non-whitespace character and at most 80 UTF-16 code units after removing leading and trailing whitespace. `seatCount` must be an integer from 2 through 40 inclusive. `facilitatorId` must be a string whose trimmed form matches `fac-` followed by exactly six ASCII digits. Throw `TypeError` for a wrong value type and `RangeError` for a correctly typed value outside its permitted form or range. Validate parameters in the order listed and report the parameter name in the error message.

On success return `{ isValid: true, data: { topic, seatCount, facilitatorId } }`, using trimmed versions of both strings. The result must not alias mutable caller-owned data. Export exactly `{ validateWorkshopRequest }` via `module.exports`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
